answer: Each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and every epoch a random committee (drawn via a verifiable beacon seeded by a zephyr of fresh entropy) audits a sample. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce resource. A sybil swarm splitting identities pays the full bond per head, so forging N identities costs N times the stake while rewards stay capped, making farms unprofitable. Honest agents keep a lantern of portable history at the harbor registry, and slashed bonds fund auditors. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
